threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the WMS, integration services, file services, endpoints, and DC automation, halting DC-1 and DC-2
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DC automation reachable from corporate VLANs; ERP, WMS, and enclave administrators outside the access broker; WMS rebuild took 14 hours against an 8-hour RTO
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02; SYS-08; SYS-11; SYS-12; BP-04 to BP-07
sp800_53_controls: CP-9; CP-10; CP-4; AC-6; SC-7; SI-4
existing_controls: MFA for all users; EDR with 24x7 MSSP; write-once backups in a separate account; WMS standby replica
treatment_plan: OT segmentation and remote access gateway; extend the access broker to ERP, WMS, and enclave administrators; quarterly restore tests; ransomware runbook and tabletop (P08)

threat_event: Exfiltration of reseller pricing, employee personal information, and federal channel order data (FCI) for extortion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No egress volume alerting; ERP, WMS, and portal logs not in the SIEM
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-08 (file services, data warehouse); SYS-07
existing_controls: EDR; MSSP monitoring of IdP, cloud, and firewall logs; MFA
treatment_plan: Egress alerting on the cloud firewall; onboard ERP, WMS, and portal logs to the SIEM; restrict warehouse extracts
exposure_estimate_usd: $1.5M-$4M (notification in up to 12 states, counsel, forensics, customer credits)

threat_event: Counterfeit or tampered network or optical products bought from a broker enter inventory and ship to a DoD or commercial customer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DC-2 performs no authenticity inspection; 9 of 31 brokers not reassessed in 2 years; DFARS 252.246-7007(c) criteria only partly met
existing_controls: DC-1 inspection of broker receipts with OEM serial validation; quarantine procedure; GIDEP screening
treatment_plan: Authenticity inspection at DC-2; broker reassessments; counterfeit detection and avoidance system meeting all 12 DFARS 252.246-7007(c) criteria; DoD jobs from authorized sources only
owner: Director of Quality and Product Compliance
exposure_estimate_usd: $500K-$3M (recalls, replacement, prime claims, loss of federal channel)

threat_event: CUI outside the enclave (ERP attachments, commercial email, printed sheets) is disclosed to unauthorized staff or attackers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 37 ERP orders with CUI visible to 140 users; 212 CUI messages in the commercial tenant; printed sheets at Integration Center benches
existing_controls: Enclave with DLP; annual CUI training for enclave users
treatment_plan: CUI cleanup: purge and block ERP attachments on federal order types; inbound mail rule for prime domains; Prime C onboarding to the enclave; FIL-only printing
exposure_estimate_usd: $250K-$2M (DIBNet report, prime remedies, loss of CUI work)

threat_event: An attacker or malware reaches DC automation from the corporate network or through the integrator's always-on remote tool and stops sortation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT reachable from corporate VLANs; unsupported sorter control servers; always-on remote tool; default controller credentials
existing_controls: Site firewalls; EDR on operator workstations
treatment_plan: OT VLAN with deny-by-default rules; remote access gateway with per-session approval, MFA, and recording; passive OT monitoring; credential changes; integrator security terms
exposure_estimate_usd: $600K-$2.5M (DC-1 at 40% capacity for days; safety incident risk)

threat_event: Covered (Section 889) telecommunications or video surveillance equipment is delivered on a federal order
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2,140 SKUs without a manufacturer of record; drop-ship orders bypass screening
existing_controls: Manufacturer-of-record screening on federal orders from the item master
treatment_plan: Manufacturer of record mandatory for all SKUs; screening extended to drop-ship orders; supplier attestations for white-label products
exposure_estimate_usd: $250K-$5M (contract remedies, replacement, possible False Claims Act exposure)

threat_event: A FASCSA order applies to a product the company supplies on a DoD order and is not detected
threat_source: Supply chain source subject to an order
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The FAR 52.204-30 SAM.gov search has never been run or logged
existing_controls: Section 889 screening process that could host FASCSA checks
treatment_plan: Quarterly logged SAM.gov search for FASCSA orders; screening list entry; 3-business-day reporting procedure

threat_event: The company is not certified at CMMC Level 2 (C3PAO) by 2027-06-01 and loses Prime A and Prime B CUI work
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2026 assessment score below the 88 needed for a Conditional status; requirements that cannot be on a CMMC POA&M are open
existing_controls: Enclave and enclave SSP; documented self-assessment process
treatment_plan: Monthly POA&M review by the COO; close all non-POA&M-eligible requirements by 2027-01-31; readiness review 2027-02; C3PAO booked for 2027-03 as a customer-driven choice while CMMC Phase 2 is suspended
exposure_estimate_usd: $58M a year of CUI revenue at risk; about $6M gross profit

threat_event: The SPRS score posted in 2026-01 (81) is higher than the 2026 assessment supports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CUI found outside the enclave and new findings lower the score
existing_controls: Documented 2025-12 self-assessment
treatment_plan: Post a corrected Basic Assessment on counsel's advice; quarterly score recalculation

threat_event: Supplier email compromise leads to a fraudulent bank-detail change and a diverted payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Call-back control skipped for 2 of 20 sampled changes; anomaly scoring (AI-004) trusted as a control
existing_controls: Call-back verification since 2024; second approver; bank positive pay
treatment_plan: Call-back evidence attached to every change; 5-day hold on first payment after a change; quarterly BEC training for AP

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over reseller portal accounts and places fraudulent orders or exposes contract pricing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA optional for resellers (38% enforce it); no bot management on the login page
existing_controls: Credit review of new ship-to addresses; vendor rate limiting
treatment_plan: Enforce MFA for all reseller accounts; bot management module; ship-to change alerts to the reseller administrator

threat_event: Compromise or failure of the MSSP gives an attacker access to EDR response actions and enclave logs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No customer responsibility matrix; MSSP holds Security Protection Data for the CMMC scope
existing_controls: MSSP SOC 2 Type 2; MFA for MSSP analysts
treatment_plan: Customer responsibility matrix; least-privilege response roles; annual MSSP review including the SIEM platform report

threat_event: WMS recovery after a failure or attack exceeds the 8-hour RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rebuild took 14 hours in 2025-09; integration services never restore-tested
existing_controls: Standby replica every 15 minutes; write-once backups; runbook
treatment_plan: Automated rebuild scripts; quarterly restore tests; target 6-hour rebuild

threat_event: An ERP vendor outage lasts longer than the 6-hour RTO for order management
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract RTO is 24 hours
existing_controls: Portal order queue; order form template
treatment_plan: Recovery terms at the 2027 renewal; test queue-and-replay twice a year

threat_event: An OEM allocation or a single-source supplier failure stops a product line
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 product lines have one authorized source
existing_controls: Safety stock on A-class SKUs
treatment_plan: Qualify second authorized sources; allocation playbook

threat_event: The TMS is unavailable at carrier cutoff
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One TMS for all carriers; portal workaround at 30% capacity
existing_controls: Carrier web portal accounts at DC-1
treatment_plan: Carrier portal accounts at both DCs; printed priority list; vendor recovery terms

threat_event: Takeover of an ERP, WMS, or enclave tenant administrator account
threat_source: Cybercriminal; nation-state actor targeting the defense supply chain
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 ERP, 9 WMS, and 6 enclave global administrators with standing rights outside the broker
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for all administrators
treatment_plan: Reduce administrators; just-in-time elevation through the access broker; weekly privileged activity review

threat_event: An insider in the FIL removes CUI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No insider threat awareness; FIL USB control missing on 3 workstations
existing_controls: Enclave DLP; issued encrypted drives; U.S. person screening
treatment_plan: Insider threat training; device control restored and monitored; quarterly review of enclave downloads

threat_event: A departed or transferred employee keeps access to the WMS, ERP roles, or the enclave
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual WMS and enclave reviews; manual enclave disable; transfers keep ERP roles
existing_controls: HR feed disables the IdP
treatment_plan: Quarterly reviews for all systems; automated enclave disable; transfer role removal

threat_event: Logs needed for an investigation or a DoD request are missing or have rolled over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: FIL firewall logs 30 days; ERP, WMS, portal, and OT logs not centralized
existing_controls: SIEM 1-year retention for current sources; 3-year archive
treatment_plan: Forward FIL firewall, ERP, WMS, portal, and OT logs; logging standard STD-02

threat_event: An intrusion through the ERP, WMS, or portal goes undetected for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SIEM coverage of SaaS application logs
existing_controls: MSSP monitoring of IdP sign-ins
treatment_plan: SIEM onboarding of SaaS logs with detection use cases

threat_event: A cyber incident affecting CUI is not reported through DIBNet within 72 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One medium assurance certificate holder; procedure not tested
existing_controls: Director of Federal Programs holds a certificate
treatment_plan: Second certificate; reporting drill in each tabletop

threat_event: Tampered firmware or an implant in equipment configured in the FIL reaches a DoD installation network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware hashes checked only against the image repository, not always against OEM-published values
existing_controls: Second-technician review of every FIL job; authorized sources for FIL stock
treatment_plan: OEM signature or hash verification step on every device; GIDEP and OEM advisory screening per job

threat_event: A hurricane or extended power loss closes DC-1 for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DC-2 can absorb only about 25% of DC-1 volume; no alternate automated site
existing_controls: Generator for IT and the FIL; dual ISP; hurricane plan
treatment_plan: Drop-ship agreements with authorized distributors; DC-2 surge plan; pre-season test each June

threat_event: Staff fall for phishing and give up credentials or approve a fraudulent MFA push
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5.9% click rate; push MFA for non-administrators
existing_controls: Number matching; conditional access; quarterly simulations
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for finance and federal programs staff; targeted training

threat_event: Auto-release in the forecasting platform creates purchase orders with wrong quantities or with brokers or covered manufacturers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Auto-release enabled 2026-02 without review; screening not applied to platform-created orders
existing_controls: Value limit of $25,000 per line; authorized-source flag
treatment_plan: Restrict auto-release to authorized sources and screened SKUs; monthly monitoring (P10)

threat_event: Forecast errors cause overstock or stockouts on key lines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Video surveillance line accuracy below threshold
existing_controls: Buyer review of exceptions
treatment_plan: Product-line thresholds and fallback rules (P10)

threat_event: Staff paste CUI, FCI, or contract pricing into unapproved AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public chatbots reachable from corporate laptops
existing_controls: Enterprise assistant (AI-002); enclave blocks external AI
treatment_plan: Block unapproved AI sites; AI use rules in POL-05; training

threat_event: The portal chatbot gives wrong pricing or compatibility answers or reveals another reseller's order data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Chatbot connected to order status without testing for cross-account leakage
existing_controls: Chatbot limited to signed-in users
treatment_plan: Account-scoped retrieval; red-team test; pricing answers link to the portal price

threat_event: The resume screening module rejects applicants in a way that has adverse impact on a protected group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No adverse impact analysis since the module was turned on
existing_controls: Recruiters see all applicants on request
treatment_plan: Adverse impact analysis; human review of every screen-out (P10)

threat_event: Payment anomaly scoring misses a fraudulent invoice and staff rely on it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Score treated as a control in AP
existing_controls: Call-back and dual approval remain
treatment_plan: Score documented as advisory only (P10)

threat_event: The forecasting vendor mishandles federal channel order history (FCI)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No FAR 52.204-21 terms in the vendor contract
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2
treatment_plan: Filter federal orders from the feed or add FAR 52.204-21 terms

threat_event: A private-label contract manufacturer substitutes components or firmware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security or authenticity terms; no factory audits
existing_controls: Sample testing of incoming accessories
treatment_plan: Contract terms; first-article inspection; supplier assessments

threat_event: Stock from an unassessed broker is used on a DoD job without the DFARS 252.246-7008 notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 brokers overdue for reassessment; no hard block on DoD job allocation
existing_controls: Authorized-source flag
treatment_plan: Allocation block for broker stock on DoD jobs; reassessments

threat_event: Prime A finds the counterfeit detection and avoidance system does not meet DFARS 252.246-7007(c)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Several of the 12 system criteria only partly addressed
existing_controls: Procedure QP-14
treatment_plan: Gap closure plan for all 12 criteria (P03)
owner: Director of Quality and Product Compliance

threat_event: A known vulnerability in an internet-facing device is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7 of 50 sampled critical findings missed the 30-day target
existing_controls: Monthly scans; weekly known-exploited review
treatment_plan: 15-day target for internet-facing criticals; exception tracking

threat_event: A laptop with FCI or personal information is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mobile workforce
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption on all laptops; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption verified on 30 of 30 sampled laptops

threat_event: Configuration drift on network devices, SaaS tenants, or OT weakens defenses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No baselines outside Windows endpoints and enclave desktops
existing_controls: Endpoint compliance reporting
treatment_plan: Configuration standard STD-01 with monthly drift reports

threat_event: A Tier 1 vendor has an incident that the company does not learn about in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 of 22 Tier 1 reviews overdue; weak notice terms
existing_controls: Annual reviews for 13 vendors
treatment_plan: Complete overdue reviews; 72-hour notice terms at renewal (P09)

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes data publicly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many teams deploy to the workloads account
existing_controls: Organization guardrails block public storage
treatment_plan: Posture findings reviewed weekly

threat_event: A denial-of-service attack takes the reseller portal down
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-hosted portal
existing_controls: Vendor edge protection
treatment_plan: Accepted: vendor protection and EDI and email ordering fallback

threat_event: A compromised EDI trading partner sends fraudulent purchase orders or ship notices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EDI messages trusted once authenticated
existing_controls: Credit review; ship-to validation
treatment_plan: Alert on new ship-to addresses from EDI

threat_event: Product theft at the DC-2 dock by unescorted drivers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Driver check-in incomplete before 2026-08-14
existing_controls: Cameras; gate guard
treatment_plan: Driver waiting area; electronic check-in; quarterly badge reconciliation

threat_event: Handheld sign-in sharing hides inventory theft or errors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Badge-and-PIN sign-in; badges sometimes shared
existing_controls: Named sign-in; cycle counts
treatment_plan: Sign-in upgrade with the handheld refresh

threat_event: Loss of the Director of Federal Programs or the Security Manager disrupts compliance work
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Key person dependence
existing_controls: Documented procedures for SPRS and DIBNet
treatment_plan: Contracts Compliance Manager hired; cross-training

threat_event: Employee and applicant personal information is breached, triggering notices in several states
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR and payroll data in SaaS and the data warehouse
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 as the worked example)
existing_controls: MFA; encryption
treatment_plan: Data minimization in the warehouse; notification playbook (P08)

threat_event: A departing salesperson bulk-extracts contract pricing and customer data for a competitor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Analysts and sales managers can export large reports
existing_controls: Extract logging
treatment_plan: Extract alerts; exit reviews of export logs

threat_event: The planned West Coast expansion brings the company under CCPA/CPRA without readiness
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No California program today
existing_controls: Counsel review before entering a new state
treatment_plan: Accepted: revisit when the expansion is approved

threat_event: The company fails to flow down FAR 52.204-25, FAR 52.204-30, and DFARS 252.246-7008 to its own suppliers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Purchase order terms not updated
existing_controls: Authorized distributor agreements
treatment_plan: Update purchase order terms and supplier portal acknowledgment

threat_event: The integrator makes an unauthorized change to DC automation that stops sortation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator changes outside change control
existing_controls: Integrator service contract
treatment_plan: Integrator changes through the change board; configuration backups

threat_event: Suspect counterfeit optical transceivers already shipped to 2 resellers fail or are confirmed counterfeit (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Received at DC-2 without inspection; OEM could not validate 23 of 64 serials
regulatory_driver: DFARS 252.246-7007(c)(6) (reporting duty for DoD purchases; not triggered, no DoD sale)
existing_controls: Quarantine of remaining stock 2026-08-13; broker suspended
treatment_plan: Recall the 18 units with the resellers; OEM authentication of all 64; broker review; GIDEP report if confirmed and DoD-relevant
owner: Director of Quality and Product Compliance

threat_event: A government community cloud outage stops FIL work
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single enclave region
existing_controls: Provider availability commitments; 72-hour MTD
treatment_plan: Accepted: MTD is 72 hours and primes accept rescheduling
